title: The Weather Today
description: Practise be, there is and like + -ing, and write a holiday postcard about the weather.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "it is" to talk about the weather: it is cold.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with is or are.
exercises.text: There ___ lots of snow in the mountains.
exercises.explanation: Snow is uncountable, so use "there is": there is lots of snow.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: It + is + weather adjective + time: It is sunny today.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: We do not like the rain.
exercises.explanation: With we, make the negative with don't (do not): we don't like.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: When it snows, I like ___ a snowman.
exercises.explanation: After like, use the -ing form: I like making a snowman.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My sister and I has got new boots.
answers: My sister and I have got new boots.
exercises.explanation: My sister and I = we, so use "have got": we have got.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with seasons: in summer, in winter.

exercises.prompt: Complete with can or can't.
exercises.text: It is wet and windy. We ___ play outside.
exercises.explanation: Use "can't" (cannot) when something is not possible.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are lots of cloud in the sky.
answers: There are lots of clouds in the sky.
exercises.explanation: Use a plural noun (-s) after "there are lots of": lots of clouds.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I don't like walking in the rain.
In the rain I don't like walking.
exercises.explanation: Subject + don't like + verb-ing: I don't like walking.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I ___ got an umbrella in my bag.
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with I, you, we and they: I have got.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: It ___ (snow) a lot here in winter.
exercises.explanation: With it, add -s to the verb: it snows.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: It is cold, ___ I wear my coat.
exercises.explanation: Use "so" to give a result: it is cold, so I wear my coat.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an umbrella.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: It + isn't + adjective: It isn't hot today.

exercises.prompt: Write the possessive adjective for the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Put on ___ (you) hat. It is cold!
exercises.explanation: The possessive adjective for "you" is "your": your hat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ there any clouds in the sky?
exercises.explanation: Make questions with "Are there" + a plural noun: Are there any clouds?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: It is very cold on January.
answers: It is very cold in January.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with months: in January.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We can swim in the sea.
Can we swim in the sea?
In the sea we can swim.
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: We can swim in the sea.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of be.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns: the days are.

task.prompt: You are on holiday. Write a postcard to a friend about the weather.
contentPoints: Say what the weather is like today.
Say what you can do in this weather.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Max,

I'm in the mountains with my family. Today it is cold and snowy. We can ski and make a snowman. I wear my big coat, a hat and warm boots every day. It is great fun!

See you soon,
Oscar
